Zoe De La Paz moved to Yellowstone National Park in June to work as a seamstress, where she alters and repairs uniforms for thousands of employees. That mentality helped her gather the courage to quit her corporate day job in Chicago, break into the costuming field, and move to Yellowstone National Park to work as a seamstress — a path she hopes will eventually take her to New York City to work on Broadway and in film productions. "It was luck because I happened to be there at that place and at that time," she says, adding that she believes "you can manufacture luck in your life.". "It was really scary to be leaving corporate and chase [my] dreams, and do the thing the adults are telling you, 'you shouldn't do that,'" she says.
